retrospective_decision_or_rationale: Evaluate multiple COTS glass-cockpit architectures against aircraft-level capability, integration, HMI, support and lifecycle factors rather than selecting by display features alone.
Use/assess an avionics data-interface path to integrate retained GNS 430-family navigation capability with the Dynon cockpit.
Treat spare LRUs and OEM repair/support as part of the fleet support concept; avoid assuming all board-level repair can be performed locally.
Preserve/restore settings and databases after display replacement before re-test/flight.
Keep certification/TSO/type-acceptance suitability separate from functional flight performance in customer evaluation.
Keep the G3X comparison deck separate from the G900X/G950 prototype/evaluation track in the retrospective model.
Abstract controlled implementation detail while retaining requirement-interface-verification traceability.
